text: The major of Public Administration aims to cultivate high-quality talents who possess modern management knowledge, techniques and abilities and can engage in management work in administrative departments of public institutions such as culture and education, sports, health, environmental protection and social insurance. It integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as management, political science, law, and economics, and is a highly comprehensive and interdisciplinary subject. It aims to cultivate compound management talents with solid foundations, broad knowledge, and outstanding professional abilities that are needed by society.
